data.title: Funding for research into hydrogen resources
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: Exploratory research work into the commercial viability of hydrogen resources in Southland will be accelerated by a grant of up to $17.8 million from the Regional Infrastructure Fund.

128503.label: Funding for research into hydrogen resources

data.title: Funding for better connections in Kaikōura
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: Locals and visitors will benefit from improved access in central Kaikōura, with the Government providing a grant of up to $500,000 from the Regional Infrastructure Fund for new facilities.

128502.label: Funding for better connections in Kaikōura

data.title: Milford Tourism concession in place for summer
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: A new concession agreement with Milford Sound Tourism Limited has now been signed – bringing certainty for the iconic tourism destination ahead of summer.

128501.label: Milford Tourism concession in place for summer

data.title: Geothermal exploration for Taranaki and Waikato
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: Two Māori-led early exploration projects in Taranaki and South Waikato could unlock new geothermal opportunities beyond New Zealand’s established geothermal areas, supporting regional growth and making greater use of home-grown energy resources.

128500.label: Geothermal exploration for Taranaki and Waikato

data.title: Wairarapa grain storage set to benefit farmers
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: A $1.55 million loan from the Regional Infrastructure Fund will support the establishment of a new grain drying and storage facility in Carterton, improving costs, efficiencies, and resilience.

128498.label: Wairarapa grain storage set to benefit farmers

data.title: Foxton wetland restoration backed by RIF
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: The restoration and development of Piriharakeke, the river loop at Foxton, will be supported by a grant of up to $3 million from the Regional Infrastructure Fund.

128499.label: Foxton wetland restoration backed by RIF

data.title: Making best use of railway land
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: The Government has extended KiwiRail's leas of railway land by 100 years (to 2170). This provides greater certainty for KiwiRail so it can develop commercial lease opportunities for vacant or unutilised land.

128504.label: Making best use of railway land

data.title: National Day of Reflection: remembering survivors of abuse in care
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: The Government is encouraging New Zealanders to mark today’s National Day of Reflection to remember and acknowledge the survivors of abuse, harm and neglect in care.

128516.label: National Day of Reflection: remembering survivors of abuse in care

data.title: Welcoming progress on proposed wool levy
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: Minister Mark Patterson encourages wool growers to engage in the upcoming opportunity to vote on a proposed wool levy.

128517.label: Welcoming progress on proposed wool levy

data.title: Medsafe approves first medicine using the ‘Rule of Two’ pathway
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: Paliperidone is the first medicine to be approved in New Zealand via the expedited ‘Rule of Two’ pathway, says Associate Health Minister David Seymour.

128519.label: Medsafe approves first medicine using the ‘Rule of Two’ pathway
